K1.description: last permissible date equals the effective deadline

K3.description: verdict agrees with the sign of delta_days

K5.description: compliance flag agrees with the verdict (paraphrase control)

K4.description: verdict agrees with presented vs last permissible date (DERIVED from K1+K2+K3; redundancy check only)

_note: Rates are over complete batteries only. K4 is derived and excluded from incoherence_rate.
_analytic: Engine fields are projections of a single computation. A zero violation rate here is analytic, not an empirical win -- report it as a property of the architecture.
